_comment: Merge this into your existing settings.json when you are ready to
switch from the probe hook to the real Hook Client.
escalation_timeout (120 s) < HOOK_DEADLINE_SECONDS (130 s) < timeout here (150 s)
Windows path for main.py: adjust if your project root differs.
NEW (Bug 6): commands use 'py -3' (the Windows Python launcher). 'python3' may not exist on Windows
or may open the Microsoft Store, and a hook that fails to start does NOT block the tool call.
The probe hook entries in probe_settings.json can be REMOVED once
you switch to this settings file — the Supervisor service logs everything.
